parts.name: Sword Route
parts.desc: Goal: 30. After you deal excess DMG, gain that many counters (max. 5). Reward: Fill your hand with {Pixel Friends}. If your opponent has 15 or less HP, give all ally monsters +1/+2 and all monsters in your hand +1/+1.

parts.name: Shadow Mantle
parts.desc: Quest: Begin the _Sword Route_. Magic: Deal 6 DMG to an enemy monster. Deal the excess DMG to its adjacent monsters.

parts.name: Pixel Friend
parts.desc: Haste. Darkspawn.

parts.name: Handsome Lancer
parts.desc: Magic: Switch: [[Summon two {Thrashing Machines} with 2/2]] or [[one with 4/4 and Taunt]].

parts.name: Catty's Mom
parts.desc: After an ally Program is triggered, gain 1 G.

parts.name: Virus
parts.desc: KR. After a monster dies, summon a _Silenced_ {Virus}.

parts.name: Caged Eyes
parts.desc: Transparency. After an ally takes DMG, deal 1 DMG to the lowest HP enemy. If it's the opponent, deal 4 DMG and Silence this.

parts.name: Coder Dog
parts.desc: Magic: Choose a card in your hand. Cast {Dream} on it, then cast {Arcane Codes.}

parts.name: Shop Rouxls
parts.desc: Magic: Add a {Jar of Worms} to your hand. Turn end: Switch: Add a [[{Dainty Scard}]] or [[{Brave Axe}]] to your hand.

parts.name: Dainty Scarf
parts.desc: Give a monster in your hand +3 HP.

parts.name: Brave Axe
parts.desc: Give a monster in your hand +2 ATK.

parts.name: Aqua's Danmaku
parts.desc: Loop (1). Magic: Deal 1 DMG to all enemies.

parts.name: Aqua Kris
parts.desc: Turn start: Add a {Knife} to your hand.

parts.name: Honey
parts.desc: After the monster on this slot attacks, if it is damaged, heal 2 HP to it and this effect expires.

parts.name: Honey Cooler
parts.desc: Magic: Enchant all ally slots with _Honey_.

parts.name: Honeybear
parts.desc: Support: Enchant the attacker's slot with _Honey_.

parts.name: Fortune Catti
parts.desc: Magic: Look at the top 3 cards of your deck and choose one. Erase it to draw 2 cards.

parts.name: Netskie
parts.desc: Magic: Enchant this slot with _Fluffy $$$$ing Tail_.

parts.name: Fluffy $$$$ing Tail
parts.desc: After a non-Charge non-DT monster is played, turn the monster on this slot into a copy of it with this monster's current stats. Turn end: If this slot is empty, this effect expires.

parts.name: Garden Fox
parts.desc: Magic: Turn into a copy of a non-DT monster with this monster's stats.
